wellness.areaHint: Where you feel it: right calf, adductor…
wellness.noteHint: Optional. The coaching staff will read it.

recent.title: Your last few days
recent.description: Sum of the five answers, from 5 to 25. Your average: {mean}.
recent.summary: Wellbeing over the last {days} days, averaging {mean} out of 25

familyTests.title: Fitness tests
familyTests.description: Their progress in each test. Only compared with themselves.

methodology.title: Methodology
methodology.description: Whether teams plan and close their sessions and split their contents the way the section sets out.

targets.title: Target split by category
targets.description: Share of minutes the section wants for each kind of content.
targets.empty: The section hasn't set a target split yet.
targets.emptyConfigure: No target split yet. Set it in the training settings.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: From the start of the season until today.
teams.empty: The section has no teams this season.
teams.summary: Split of {team}'s {minutes} minutes of drills by kind of content

trainingConfig.title: Training settings
trainingConfig.description: The section's tracking, recommendations, methodology, contents and template weeks.
trainingConfig.readOnly: You can view these settings. Changing them requires managing the training library.

tracking.title: Tracking
tracking.description: How much is recorded in each session. It can be changed at any time.

basic.name: Basic
basic.detail: Objective, drills and attendance, with a group RPE when closing. Designed for youth teams.

full.name: Full
full.detail: Also each player's RPE, daily wellbeing and fitness tests. For teams with a fitness coach.

tracking.formativeHint: In youth teams, the share of match minutes is also monitored.

thresholds.title: Recommendation thresholds
thresholds.description: The figure at which each alert appears. The sport suggests values; the section adjusts them.
thresholds.resetBody: Any changes the section made to the thresholds will be lost.

weeklyLoadHigh.label: Heavy week (times the average)
weeklyLoadHigh.hint: Alerts when planned load exceeds the previous four weeks' average by this factor.

weeklyLoadLow.label: Light week (times the average)
weeklyLoadLow.hint: Alerts when planned load falls below this factor.

acwrHigh.label: High acute:chronic ratio
acwrHigh.hint: Per-player alert above this ratio. It's a warning, not an injury prediction.

finishingDropPoints.label: Drop in shooting accuracy (points)
finishingDropPoints.hint: Percentage points below the season average.

turnoverRatio.label: Rise in turnovers (times the average)
turnoverRatio.hint: 1.3 means 30% more turnovers per match than the average.

earlyFoulMinute.label: Early foul limit (minute)
earlyFoulMinute.hint: Reaching the foul limit before this minute of the half.

lateGoalsShare.label: Goals conceded late (%)
lateGoalsShare.hint: Share of goals conceded in the last minutes of each half.

lateMinutes.label: End of the half (minutes)
lateMinutes.hint: Final minutes of each half that count as late.

recoveryMinutes.label: Recovery from (minutes played)
recoveryMinutes.hint: The next day, recovery for those who played this many minutes or more.

compensatoryMinutes.label: Compensatory up to (minutes played)
compensatoryMinutes.hint: Compensatory session for those who played fewer minutes than this.

focusMinutes.label: Minimum minutes on the individual objective
focusMinutes.hint: Minutes of each player's objective contents over three weeks.

methodology.title: Target content split
methodology.description: For each category, the share of minutes for each kind of content. The methodology page compares it.
methodology.noCategories: The section has no categories. Create them in the section to set a split by age.

contents.title: Contents
contents.description: What gets trained. Each content can point to the match actions that measure it, so recommendations can link matches and training.
contents.archived: {name} was already in use, so it has been archived.
contents.confirmRemoveBody: If it is already in drills or sessions, it is archived and no longer suggested.

contentSheet.description: It shows up in the library, in sessions and in recommendations.
contentSheet.name: Name
contentSheet.nameHint: Short and recognisable: “Playing out under pressure”.
contentSheet.relatedHint: Up to 12. If they drop in matches, the recommendation suggests this content.
contentSheet.relatedCodesHint: Action keys separated by commas: goal, turnover…
contentSheet.codeTaken: There is already a content with that name in the section.

templates.title: Template weeks
templates.description: Which session goes on each day relative to the match. Teams apply them from their week view.
templates.emptyHint: A one-match week and a two-match week cover almost everything.
templates.confirmRemoveBody: Weeks already planned with it won't change.

templateSheet.description: Each day relative to the match: MD is match day, MD-1 the day before, MD+1 the day after.
templateSheet.name: Name
templateSheet.timeHint: If the team has no training in the calendar that day, applying the week creates one at this time (19:00 if left empty).
templateSheet.nameTaken: There is already a template week with that name.
